title: Testing foundations
description: Thistlecombe Farm packs vegetable boxes for the villages around it, and every change to its code breaks something that a customer finds first. As its new developer you write the tests that catch those mistakes before Friday's boxes go out: prices, packing lists, subscriptions, deliveries, orders, the shed's stock, the order cut-off, payments, the van and the bills. You learn to write tests from the very first one, read what a failure tells you, test code that waits or reads the clock, and stand in for what you do not control. Then you make your tests ones you can trust: tests that stand alone, survive a rewrite, choose their cases well, and come before the code.

parts.title: Code that waits and things you do not control
